# CI-HERO-RADIO-OBSERVER-001

Authority: [#2318](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2318), supporting product #2317 and separately owned native runner #2319. New read-only observation component; validation Draft NEVER MERGE. Original layout run42462071179 remains2 scoped PASS/2FAIL, without retrospectively inventing missing radio properties.

`installRadioObserver({panelSelector,maxEvents=256})` is serialized with `evaluateHandle`. It returns `snapshot(heldId=null)`, `readEvents()` and `dispose()`. No module closure is needed in the browser. Internal identities never become DOM attributes. Events cap at the supplied1–2048 budget; retained identities cap2048. Overflow is explicit and invalidates acceptance. Dispose removes all listeners and releases retained nodes.

Snapshots carry schema1, wall/monotonic times, root identity, current/held nodes, the complete raw product candidate array, separate radio-eligible IDs and intended checked-group IDs, submit descriptor and details states. Descriptors retain identity/connectivity, type/name/value/checked/disabled/effective disabled/tabIndex, form/root ownership, dimensions, own styles and every ancestor's visibility/hidden/inert/disclosure/summary relationship. Raw ordering uses the unchanged shared product selector/own-style filter. The separate checked-group projection is an observation assumption for this selected-gold scenario, not a replacement implementation or proof about no-checked/active-unchecked navigation.

Window-capture listeners observe keydown before the document trap and record initial defaultPrevented. A microtask records an explicitly nonfinal captureCheckpoint with eventPhase: native dispatch may checkpoint between listeners. The actual Event is retained until a later snapshot/readEvents call following the runner's awaited keyboard action. Only eventPhase0 permits final defaultPrevented/current-focus sampling; immediate snapshot finalizes first, then records its own timestamp. In-dispatch reads leave final unset. This timing correction was registered in #2318 comment6719422594 before editing. Focusin/focusout/input/change retain actual sequence/target/current focus. Listeners never preventDefault, stop propagation, dispatch input, focus or write state. Full metadata is returned by value; browser events are not serialized as mutable handles.

Trial contract: `{index,direction,before,after:[immediate,raf1,raf2],events:{events,overflow}}`. Runner owns genuine inputs, records a cursor before the key, then passes only the subsequent event slice. Each after snapshot retains the original active-node ID: gold for forward, first boundary for reverse. Native Shift can be held before the reverse cursor so its setup keydown is distinct from the one required Tab. Screenshots/geometry and input timestamps remain runner-owned evidence; the three sample positions must actually bracket immediate and consecutive animation frames.

Before each trial, require visible/connected checked gold and unchecked item with identical name/form/root, raw final positions, intended final gold and disabled submit. Fixed forward must prevent Tab and focus first; fixed reverse must prevent Shift+Tab and focus gold. Baseline forward requires unprevented genuine Tab and BODY outside in every after sample. Replaced/disconnected nodes, changed candidates/disclosures or delayed divergence fail instead of being mistaken for radio-boundary causation. No native input is retried until lucky PASS.

`validateRadioTrial(trial,{variant,direction})` rejects malformed evidence, overflow, wrong groups/checked states, missing/untrusted/extra keys, wrong modifiers, event phase/timing, identity replacement and incorrect immediate/delayed outcome. `validateCompletion(report,{variant,width,provenance})` requires schema1, exact1280×720 or1600×900 and exact provenance entries `qa,observer,runtime,geometry,product`, each `{head,tree,parents,clean:true}`. Baseline has forward trials1/2/3; fixed has ordered forward/reverse pairs1/2/3. Missing, duplicate or unknown trials fail.

Run the whole `.test.mjs` after locked client dependencies exist. Tests resolve the repository client's installed jsdom and execute the actual serialized observer. Offline synthetic events remain explicitly untrusted; DOM geometry and positive trusted-validator metadata are synthetic fixtures, never native traversal proof. Full actual descriptor/event/disposal/overflow tests and negative validator mutations are mandatory.

The runner must preserve immutable A runtime7dc5939f and C geometry283160ae with their complete tests, full client/server builds, exact composition/source mapping and required CI. This observer starts no browser/service or gameplay. Natural no-checked/forms/root/hidden variants unavailable in the actual fresh service remain production-mounted source tests, not invented native fixtures. Radio selection rerender/Arrow focus loss is a separate issue. Existing unchanged13-case layout acceptance, full raw pixels/protocol/economy/finalDB/cleanup and all holds remain separate gates.
